scheme_name: Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the labour department
Only family members are eligible for death benefits: dependent parents, spouse, daughter, and son (if below 21 years)
Death benefit is not payable in case of suicide
Aadhaar authentication of the dependent is required when the dependent applies
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹5.25 lakhs as death benefit and up to ₹4 lakhs as disability benefit to registered construction workers and their families.
